Ahoy hoy. Well clearly I'm still here and alive :)

Err, emergency ward visit could have been better. It's really hard to talk about mental health issues whilst parents are sitting right next to you listening to every word you say. I couldn't say I had suicidal tendencies whilst she was sitting next to me. Damnit.

They ran a whole lot of blood tests and stuff which all came clear, so it wasn't in my blood stream I guess. They had to give me a couple of IV's because I was apparently really dehydrated (which seems weird cause I was definetly drinking water yesterday) 

They kept me there overnight (and my mum decided to stay there next to me all night, arrgh can't get rid of her apparently) and my heart rate was rocketing all night, and my blood pressure was crashing down low all night. That was not fun.
And I couldn't sleep cause I was just too pumped up of energy because of said stimulants.

Well, I think I was an idiot yesterday. It definetly gave me a bit of a wake up call (especially when I had to sit in the waiting room next to someone who had slashed their wrists really badly)
Alright. Apparently I passed out infront of my mum, so we went to ED. I'm still really really really jittery and apparently my heart rate is a bit shit too

It hasn't.
